text:
Jess (Sales): quick handoff — Aurelia Therapeutics signed today. Mid-market, legal done. Requirements: Private deployment (VPC), SAML SSO, Dedicated GPUs (start: 2xA10s), semantic search + embeddings. Go-live target: ~8 weeks. Renewal in 11 months — finance pushed for a stepping discount, mark as renewal-risk = medium. Passing to CS for onboarding + to eng/support for infra.

Ravi (CS): thanks Jess. assign to me for onboarding roadmap. couple quick Qs: do they need data residency in eu-west? any PII restrictions?

Jess (Sales): no EU residency, they’re US east. PII: PHI-ish — they said de-identified clinical notes, but legal wants encryption-at-rest + KMS. contact: marie@aurelia (CTO) and dan@aurelia (platform lead).

Ravi (CS): got it. I'll schedule kickoff with them. tentative owners: Ravi = onboarding lead, Ava = enablement (training + runbook), Marta = support SLA contact, Tom = infra/priv deployments.

Ava (Enablement): can prepare a 60m enablement session + a short admin runbook. prefer to do recording + slides. need list of users and roles from Aurelia before session.

Marta (Support): will set up a priority support plan and alerting playbook. need to know expected qps and token volumes for cost estimates. Jess any numbers?

Jess (Sales): trial logs show ~30 rps bursts, 1k tokens/min typical, expect ramp to 100 rps over 3 months. will send spreadsheet offline.

Tom (Eng): for Private we need a ticket to infra with sizing + network allowlist. also quantify latency SLOs. Are they expecting sub-200ms tail?

Ravi (CS): they expect ~<250ms median for chat, but embeddings can be higher. I'll confirm SLA expectations during kickoff.

Ravi (CS): Action items (short):
```
- Create onboarding project in CS workspace (owner: Ravi)
- Enablement session scheduled (owner: Ava)
- Create infra request for Private deployment + KMS (owner: Tom)
- Support priority plan + runbook (owner: Marta)
- Send cost/usage spreadsheet to CS (owner: Jess)
- Exec sponsor intro and renewal note (owner: Jess)
```

Tom (Eng): creating infra ticket now. tagging eng-runtime and eng-cloud teams. will include quantization/throughput options and recommended GPU profile.

DeployBot: ticket INF-4821 created by Tom for Private deploy request (linked).

Marta (Support): flagged for escalations channel and added an initial runbook template. will draft alerts for latency spikes and token-cost anomalies.

Ravi (CS): tentative timeline: week 0-1 kickoffs + SAML config, week 2 infra provision + network tests, week 3 enablement + integration support, week 4 pilot, week 6 go/no-go for full cutover. I'll confirm with Aurelia this afternoon.

Ava (Enablement): I’ll draft the training agenda and sample prompts. also prepare a short eval prompt set to track regression post-rollout.

Jess (Sales): sending exec intro email today, copying Ravi + Marta. note: finance asked for monthly usage reports and a checkpoint at month 6 for renewal pricing review.

Ravi (CS): putting combined action owners into our internal ticket tracker now. will post cal invite for kickoff after I get two preferred times from them.

Tom (Eng): quick note — if they want embeddings at scale we should consider dedicated embedding nodes to isolate token cost. including options in INF-4821.

Marta (Support): once infra is provisioned I’ll run a smoke checklist with eng and do a simulated incident to validate runbook.

Ravi (CS): cool — next updates posted here after kickoff. tagging owners: @Ava, @Tom, @Marta, @Jess. :thumbsup:

Jess (Sales): :rocket: thanks team, appreciate the quick handoff.
